refresh-interval.tooltip: How often the temperature, fan speed and panel label refresh. Higher = lower idle CPU/power.

temp-chip-name.tooltip: The /sys/class/hwmon/*/name value of the CPU temperature sensor. Default: coretemp. Leave as-is unless detection fails.

pwm-chip-name.tooltip: The /sys/class/hwmon/*/name value of the fan PWM controller. Default: asus. Leave as-is unless detection fails.
